entries.title: Psalms 132:1
segments: <<A Song of Ascents.>> Jehovah, remember for David All his affliction;

entries.title: Psalms 132:2
segments: How he sware unto Jehovah, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:

entries.title: Psalms 132:3
segments: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, Nor go up into my bed;

entries.title: Psalms 132:4
segments: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Or slumber to mine eyelids;

entries.title: Psalms 132:5
segments: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, A tabernacle for the Mighty One of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 132:6
segments: Lo, we heard of it in Ephrathah: We found it in the field of the wood.

entries.title: Psalms 132:7
segments: We will go into his tabernacles; We will worship at his footstool.

entries.title: Psalms 132:8
segments: Arise, O Jehovah, into thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of thy strength.

entries.title: Psalms 132:9
segments: Let thy priest be clothed with righteousness; And let thy saints shout for joy.

entries.title: Psalms 132:10
segments: For thy servant David's sake Turn not away the face of thine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 132:11
segments: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth; He will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

entries.title: Psalms 132:12
segments: If thy children will keep my covenant And my testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 132:13
segments: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for his habitation.

entries.title: Psalms 132:14
segments: This is my resting-place for ever: Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

entries.title: Psalms 132:15
segments: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

entries.title: Psalms 132:16
segments: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

entries.title: Psalms 132:17
segments: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 132:18
segments: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown flourish.
